title: 第二十一章 基地防御系统漏洞排查第二十章 外星文明观测日志解读
lines: 第二十一章：基地防御系统漏洞排查
凌晨三点，宇宙警备司令部基地的中央控制室依旧灯火通明。淡蓝色的全息屏幕在空气中投下层层数据流，如同悬浮的星河，映照着赵刚上校紧蹙的眉头。他指尖在虚拟键盘上飞快滑动，调出基地外层防御系统的三维模型——那是一个嵌套着十二层能量护盾的球形结构，外层覆盖着能抵御小行星撞击的合金装甲，内层则密布着反隐形探测装置和粒子束炮塔，每一处节点都标注着代表“正常”的绿色标识。
“赵队，第三区的护盾谐振频率又出现波动了。”操作台前，技术员小李的声音带着熬夜的沙哑，他指着屏幕上一闪而过的红色波纹，“这是今天第七次了，幅度不大，但频率很规律，像是被什么东西干扰。”
赵刚凑近屏幕，瞳孔在数据流中快速扫视。宇宙警备司令部基地建在地表以下五十公里的岩层中，依托天然地质结构构建了全球最严密的防御体系，别说地面攻击，就连近地轨道的卫星都无法穿透外层的空间扭曲场探测到具体位置。理论上，这样的系统不该出现“规律波动”。
“把近三天的日志调出来，对比第三区能量导管的维护记录。”赵刚的声音低沉，带着不容置疑的命令感。作为基地防御部门的负责人，他比任何人都清楚，防御系统的漏洞往往藏在最不起眼的细节里——就像三年前“空天世界”案里，那个被忽略的外星装置残片，差点撕开一道贯穿乐园的空间裂隙。
小李迅速调出文件，全息屏上立刻展开密密麻麻的参数。赵刚的目光落在三天前的一条维修记录上：“第三区b段能量导管更换，维修人员……凌峰？”
这个名字让他顿了顿。凌峰和刘佳琪加入基地才刚满两周，按流程还在适应期，按理说不该接触核心防御系统。他点开维修人员的权限记录，发现是陈曦研究员特批的临时权限——理由是“让穿越者熟悉基地能量系统，辅助研究其体质与时空能量的关联性”。
“陈曦那边有说法吗？”赵刚拨通了通讯器。
“赵队？”陈曦的声音带着刚从实验台抬起头的茫然，背景里隐约有仪器运转的嗡鸣，“凌峰那天确实跟着维修组去了第三区，他对能量导管的结构提出了个挺有意思的想法——说老式导管的接口设计有应力死角，长期高频运作容易产生能量淤积。我们测试了一下，还真有这问题，就临时让他参与了更换方案的调整。”
赵刚皱眉：“他一个1936年的军人，懂能量导管？”
“你可别小看他。”陈曦轻笑一声，“那家伙对机械结构的敏感度简直是天生的，看了两眼图纸就指出了三个工程师没发现的设计缺陷。不过……”她的语气顿了顿，“更换完之后，系统自检是全绿的，没理由出波动啊。”
挂了通讯，赵刚盯着屏幕上的波动曲线，忽然起身：“备车，去第三区b段。”
基地内部的磁悬浮车在密闭通道里无声滑行，两侧的应急灯勾勒出幽深的隧道。第三区是能量核心的次级枢纽，这里的管道外壁泛着淡紫色的光晕，空气中弥漫着臭氧的味道。赵刚沿着导管一路检查，指尖敲过冰冷的金属表面，突然在一处接口处停了下来。
“这里的螺丝型号不对。”他蹲下身，从口袋里掏出检测笔。标准接口应该用防磁六角螺丝，而眼前这个却是普通的十字螺丝，边缘甚至有轻微的变形。
“凌峰那天负责的就是这个接口？”赵刚对着通讯器问。
小李很快回复：“是的，维修记录里写了，他说标准螺丝暂时缺货，先用这个顶替，等补给到了再换。”
赵刚的眉头拧得更紧。基地的后勤系统绝不可能出现“暂时缺货”的情况，尤其是核心区域的零件。他用检测笔接触螺丝，屏幕上立刻跳出一串数据——螺丝的材质里含有微量的铁镍合金，在强磁场环境下会产生微弱的电流，恰好干扰了周围的能量场。
“把凌峰叫来。”
十分钟后，凌峰出现在第三区入口。他穿着基地配发的深灰色作训服，袖口挽到小臂，露出结实的肌肉线条。听到赵刚的质问，他没有丝毫慌乱，只是走到接口处看了一眼，便明白了问题所在。
“是我的错。”凌峰的声音很平静，“那天确实没找到标准螺丝，但这个替代品是我在废料区挑的，用磁铁试过，以为不会有问题。”
“废料区的零件能随便用在核心系统上？”赵刚的语气带着怒意，“你知道这一点点电流干扰可能导致什么后果吗？护盾谐振频率偏移超过万分之三，就会给外部探测留下窗口，甚至可能被敌人的能量武器锁定！”
凌峰沉默片刻，弯腰从工具包里拿出扳手：“我现在就换掉。”
“等等。”赵刚按住他的手，目光锐利地盯着他，“你在1936年是军械维修兵？”
“是。”凌峰点头，“在德械师的时候，负责维护迫击炮和重机枪。”

Chapter 21: Troubleshooting base defense system vulnerabilities
At three o'clock in the morning, the central control room of the Space Security Command base was still brightly lit. The light blue holographic screen casts layers of data streams in the air, like a suspended galaxy, reflecting Colonel Zhao Gang's frown. His fingertips quickly slid on the virtual keyboard to bring up the three-dimensional model of the base's outer defense system - it was a spherical structure nested with twelve layers of energy shields. The outer layer was covered with alloy armor that could withstand asteroid impacts, and the inner layer was densely covered with anti-stealth detection devices and particle beam turrets. Every node was marked with a green sign representing "normal".
"Team Zhao, the resonant frequency of the shield in the third area has fluctuated again." In front of the console, technician Xiao Li's voice was hoarse as if he had stayed up late. He pointed at the red ripples flashing across the screen. "This is the seventh time today. The amplitude is not large, but the frequency is very regular, as if it was interfered by something."
Zhao Gang moved closer to the screen and his pupils quickly scanned the data stream. The Space Security Command base is built in a rock formation fifty kilometers below the surface. It relies on natural geological structures to build the world's most stringent defense system. Not to mention ground attacks, even satellites in low-Earth orbit cannot penetrate the outer space distortion field to detect the specific location. In theory, such a system should not experience "regular fluctuations."
"Pull out the logs of the past three days and compare them with the maintenance records of the energy conduit in the third area." Zhao Gang's voice was low, with an unquestionable sense of command. As the head of the base defense department, he knows better than anyone that loopholes in the defense system are often hidden in the most inconspicuous details - just like in the "Sky World" case three years ago, the neglected alien device fragment almost tore a space rift through the paradise.
Xiao Li quickly called up the file, and the dense parameters immediately unfolded on the holographic screen. Zhao Gang's eyes fell on a maintenance record from three days ago: "Replacement of energy conduit in section b of the third area, maintenance personnel... Ling Feng?"
The name made him pause. It has only been two weeks since Ling Feng and Liu Jiaqi joined the base. According to the process, they are still in the adaptation period. Logically speaking, they should not come into contact with the core defense system. He clicked on the maintenance personnel's permission record and found that it was a temporary permission specially granted by researcher Chen Xi - the reason was to "allow the time traveler to become familiar with the base's energy system and assist in studying the correlation between their physique and space-time energy."
"Does Chen Xi have an explanation?" Zhao Gang dialed the communicator.
"Team Zhao?" Chen Xi's voice was filled with confusion as he had just raised his head from the experimental table. There was a vague hum of instruments operating in the background. "Ling Feng did follow the maintenance team to the third area that day. He came up with a very interesting idea about the structure of the energy conduit - saying that the interface design of the old conduit has a stress dead zone, and long-term high-frequency operation is prone to energy accumulation. We tested it and found that this problem really existed, so we temporarily asked him to participate in the adjustment of the replacement plan."
Zhao Gang frowned: "He was a soldier in 1936, but he knows about energy conduits?"
"Don't underestimate him." Chen Xi chuckled. "That guy's sensitivity to mechanical structures is innate. He took two glances at the drawings and pointed out three design flaws that the engineers didn't find. But..." She paused, "After the replacement, the system self-test was all green. There is no reason for fluctuations."
After hanging up the communication, Zhao Gang stared at the wave curve on the screen and suddenly stood up: "Prepare the car and go to section b of the third area."
The maglev vehicle inside the base glides silently in the closed passage, and the emergency lights on both sides outline the deep tunnel. The third area is the secondary hub of the energy core. The outer walls of the pipes here are glowing with a lavender halo, and the air is filled with the smell of ozone. Zhao Gang checked all the way along the conduit, his fingertips tapped the cold metal surface, and suddenly stopped at an interface.
"The screws here are of the wrong type." He squatted down and took out the test pen from his pocket. The standard interface should use antimagnetic hexagonal screws, but the one in front of you is an ordinary Phillips screw, and the edges are even slightly deformed.
"Is this the interface that Ling Feng was responsible for that day?" Zhao Gang asked into the communicator.
Xiao Li quickly replied: "Yes, it is written in the maintenance record. He said that the standard screws are temporarily out of stock. Use this one to replace them first, and then replace them when supplies arrive."
Zhao Gang's brows tightened even more. It is absolutely impossible for the base's logistics system to be "temporarily out of stock", especially for parts in the core area. He touched the screw with the detection pen, and a string of data immediately popped up on the screen - the material of the screw contains trace amounts of iron-nickel alloy, which will generate a weak current in a strong magnetic field environment, which just interferes with the surrounding energy field.
"Call Ling Feng."
Ten minutes later, Ling Feng appeared at the entrance to the third area. He was wearing a dark gray training uniform issued by the base, with the cuffs rolled up to his forearms, revealing strong muscle lines. Hearing Zhao Gang's question, he didn't panic at all. He just walked to the interface and took a look and understood the problem.
"It's my fault." Ling Feng's voice was calm. "I did not find the standard screw that day, but I picked this replacement in the scrap area. I tried it with a magnet and thought there would be no problem."
"Can parts from the scrap area be used in the core system at will?" Zhao Gang's tone was filled with anger. "Do you know what the consequences of this little current interference may be? If the resonant frequency of the shield deviates by more than three ten thousandths, it will leave a window for external detection, and it may even be locked by the enemy's energy weapons!"
Ling Feng was silent for a moment, then bent down and took out the wrench from the tool bag: "I'll replace it now."
"Wait a minute." Zhao Gang held his hand and stared at him sharply, "Were you an ordnance maintenance soldier in 1936?"
"Yes." Ling Feng nodded, "When I was a German weapon engineer, I was responsible for maintaining mortars and heavy machine guns."
